_comment: Two separate jobs for modded dimensions.
restrictToPockets - ACCESS. Which pocket dimensions may enter each modded dimension at all.
Keys are dimension ids, values are POCKET DIMENSION NAMES: entering the Twilight Forest from
the survival nether is still entering it from the survival pocket dimension. Ownership was
derived by diffing each standalone pack against the hub, not guessed.
regionOffsets - SEPARATION. Survival, Lost Cities and Gauntlet all legitimately own Twilight
Forest, and gating access does not stop them sharing its chunks. Duplicating the dimension per
pocket dimension breaks the mods (Twilight Forest alone has 16 classes comparing against its
own DIMENSION_KEY - portal return, progression gating, structure protection), so each pocket
dimension gets its own REGION instead: a million blocks apart, on a diagonal so no two share
an x or z band. The dimension stays genuinely twilightforest:twilight_forest, so every check
the mod makes still passes, while separate spawns, separate terrain and mutually invisible
builds all follow from the distance. World coordinates reach 30,000,000; ten pockets use a
The offset is applied on arrival and removed on the way back, so a return portal does not
strand you a million blocks from your base. [0,0] means a pocket dimension uses the origin.
